messages:
josh_platform: Heads-up — APAC node fleet is failing bootstrap in the last hour. Lots of 'kms:Decrypt AccessDenied' while fetching node certs. Seeing ~420 failed joins in 10m.

lina_sre: Yep noticed. Mostly `ap-southeast-1` warm pool. CI shows egress to KMS endpoints getting reset by firewall with 'SNI inspection triggered' logs.

sarah_sec: We've been rolling a tighter SIEM ingest rule to drop traffic with anomalous cert chains — could be related. I did a staged push at 09:12 UTC.

mike_infra: That matches timeline. Firewall pushed 09:15 UTC and then NATGW conntrack spiked. Nodes couldn't complete STS/KMS handshake.

josh_platform: ops-bot reported big audit-log shipper retry queue at the same time. Could be backpressure causing stateful inspection to misclassify KMS traffic.

ops-bot: deploy:firewall-policy updated by sarah_sec at 2026-03-21T09:15:00Z :rule-id:fw-aug-331

lina_sre: Quick mitigation proposal: temporarily add a SIEM-exempt allowlist for AWS KMS endpoints + metadata IP range for node bootstrapping. Then drain/retry the warm pool. Thoughts?

sarah_sec: Agreed as emergency. Need to restrict to exact hostnames/IPs and log-only mode. We should also update audit retention note for legal.

mike_infra: Cost note — if we start re-provisioning warm pool widely we'll trigger burst capacity from dedicated pools. That will likely add ~+$6k/day if it lasts >3h. We should scope to affected AZs only.

josh_platform: I'll open a canary change: add allowlist for `kms.ap-southeast-1.amazonaws.com` + region metadata CIDR, enable log-only for SIEM, then monitor node join rate. Rollback if anything odd.

lina_sre: Command I used to test from a stuck node: `curl -v http://169.254.169.254/latest/dynamic/instance-identity/document` -> hangs. After adding NAT exception locally the metadata returned.

sarah_sec: Post-mortem actions: 1) tighter SIEM rule should have a safety allow for cloud provider controlplane endpoints; 2) add e2e tests that simulate audit log bursts; 3) add rate-limits on shipper to avoid firewall queue saturation.

mike_infra: Also recommend we enable a fallback: if KMS decrypt fails at bootstrap, fallback to ephemeral keypair stored in sealed blob from last known-good and emit metric `node.bootstrap.fallback`. Limits blast radius.

josh_platform: I'll push the canary now, starting with one AZ. If it looks good in 10m we'll expand. Rolling update tracked in #release-war-room.

lina_sre: Can confirm one AZ canary passed, 12/12 nodes joined in 3m. No increased SIEM alerts.

sarah_sec: I've created a follow-up ticket for a formal audit change: "SIEM ingest safety list for cloud controlplane" and assigned to me and mike_infra.

mike_infra: Thanks. Monitoring costs and will send an ops summary after 6h. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

josh_platform: Closing the thread once the canary hits full expansion. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
